idea-plugin.name: FileMaker Script UI
idea-plugin.description:
Renders ```filemaker-script fenced Markdown code blocks as collapsible, FileMaker-Pro-style script accordions in the built-in Markdown preview, using fmscriptui.

Usage

Write a ```filemaker-script fenced code block in any Markdown file (see fmscriptui's fence format spec) and open the Markdown preview.
